summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting its fourth quarter and full-year financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes earnings highlights, a year-end dividend declaration of ¥24 per share (annual ¥51), and details on restricted stock and performance share unit grants. There is no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer, with no event that alters the corporate structure or ownership. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation.
